title: ResearchResult
description: What a research Smith writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules (a non-empty answer.md, an answer.html passing PitchRules, no bundle); the Smith checks it with check-result research. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

answer.description: The answer, kept by the engine and never committed unless the asker says save.

md.description: answer.md: the question, the answer, the citations and the date.

html.description: answer.html: one self-contained page by /etc/smith/pitch-guide.md; the engine lints it (PitchRules).

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
